heading: Income Tax Act 2025: Crypto VDA Tax Rules, TDS & ITR Filing
tldr: The Income Tax Act, 2025 largely continues the existing tax framework for Virtual Digital Assets (VDAs).
A flat 30% tax will still be levied on income from VDA transfers, without allowing set-off of losses.
A 1% TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) remains applicable on VDA transactions exceeding specified thresholds.
New reporting requirements under the Act mandate meticulous record-keeping of VDA transactions and wallet details.
Investors must ensure accurate disclosure of VDA income and TDS in their Income Tax Returns (ITR).
caption:
Thinking about your crypto investments and taxes? Good news: the rules for taxing your virtual digital assets (like crypto) in 2025 are pretty much the same as now. You'll still pay 30% tax on profits, and 1% TDS applies. The key is keeping good records for your tax filing. Make sure you understand how to report everything correctly!
